info.name: Flavor API v1
info.description:
Flavor is a restaurant management API built with Laravel 10 and Laravel Sanctum. This collection covers every endpoint in `routes/api.php`, versioned under `/api/v1`.

## Authentication

Most endpoints need a bearer token. Call **Auth > Login** (or **Auth > Register** then **Auth > Verify email**) and copy the `data.token` field from the response into the collection variable `token` — every other request already points at `{{token}}` via the collection-level Bearer auth, so nothing else needs editing. Tokens do not expire unless you set `SANCTUM_TOKEN_EXPIRATION` in `.env`; call **Auth > Logout** to revoke the one you are using.

## Response shape

Every endpoint returns the same envelope:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Human readable summary, or null",
  "data": {}
}
```

Paginated list endpoints add a `meta` block:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [ ... ],
  "meta": {
    "current_page": 1,
    "per_page": 15,
    "total": 42,
    "last_page": 3
  }
}
```

Validation and domain errors return `success: false` with a matching HTTP status (422 for validation, 403 for authorization, 404 for missing records) and, for validation failures, a Laravel-standard `errors` object keyed by field.

## Search, filter, sort and pagination

Every `index` endpoint in this collection accepts the same four query parameters, handled centrally by `App\Support\QueryOptions`:

| Parameter | Example | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `search` | `search=grill` | Matches against that resource's searchable columns (see each model, e.g. a meal searches its name, description and category name). |
| `filters[column]` | `filters[status]=Pending` | Exact-match or column-specific filter. Each folder lists the filters its resource supports. Repeat the key for arrays: `filters[category_id][]=1&filters[category_id][]=2`. |
| `sort_by` / `sort_dir` | `sort_by=price&sort_dir=asc` | Sorts by an allow-listed column; unrecognised columns are ignored rather than erroring. `sort_dir` is `asc` or `desc` (default `desc`). |
| `per_page` | `per_page=25` | Page size, clamped between 1 and 100 (default 15, or 12 for menu browsing). |

Combine freely: `GET /catalog/meals?search=chicken&filters[vegetarian]=0&sort_by=price&sort_dir=asc&per_page=20&page=2`.

## Language

Every user has a `preferred_locale` (`en`, `ar` or `fr`), set automatically at registration and updated whenever they switch language. Validation messages, notification text and transactional email all render in that language automatically — no request header required. To preview a *public* endpoint in another language before logging in, pass `?locale=ar` or the `X-Locale: ar` header.

## Roles

- **Guest** — the whole **Catalog** folder, plus **Auth**.
- **Customer** — everything in **Account**, plus **Profile & Notifications**. Requires a verified email.
- **Staff** — everything in **Manage**, split into folders gated by ability (`catalog`, `inventory`, `floor`, `sales`, `people`, `reports`). A manager holds every ability; other positions hold the subset described in `docs/API.md`.

See `docs/API.md` in the repository for the full endpoint reference, error catalogue and a worked authentication flow.

item.name: Catalog (public)
item.description: Read-only endpoints anyone can call -- no token required. Powers the public menu, offers page and reference data pickers.

item.name: Profile & Notifications
item.description: Anything about the signed-in user themself: profile, password, and their notification feed. Every notification is written in the language the user last selected.

request.description: The authenticated user, including their customer or employee profile if any.
Disables the account and revokes every issued token.
Paginated notification feed for the authenticated user, newest first.
Lightweight count for a bell badge.

item.name: Account (customer)
item.description: Everything a signed-in customer can do: cart, checkout, their own orders and reservations, and ratings. Requires a verified customer account.

request.description: Aggregate summary for a customer home screen: cart count, open orders, running offers, recent orders and upcoming reservations.
Places an order from the current cart.
Filters: filters[status], filters[order_type].

item.name: Manage (staff)
item.description: Staff-only endpoints. Each folder is gated by the ability the position needs -- see the collection README. Requires a verified staff account.
